# My Clients / Мої клієнти / Мои клиенты — LLMs context
# https://bilohash.com/myclient/
# Version: 1.0.0

> PHP product for **client management**, **My Clients** product, **client cabinet**, **my services** catalog,
> **Invoice** billing, **tax** (VAT / MVA / PVM / ПДВ / PDV), and **online payment** (Stripe, PayPal).

## SEO topics (primary)
1. Мої клієнти / Мои клиенты / My Clients (product brand)
2. Мої послуги / Мои услуги / My services (catalog + pricing)
3. Управління клієнтами / управление клиентами / client management
4. Invoice (billing documents)
5. Tax on invoice: VAT, MVA (NO), PVM (LT), ПДВ/НДС, PDV
6. Online payment: Stripe Checkout, PayPal REST
7. PDF Invoice

## Modules
### Admin
Clients CRUD · Services/pricing (my services) · Invoices · Company seller · FX · Tax % · Stripe/PayPal API keys

### Client cabinet
Active services · Invoice list · Pay online · PDF · Profile

## Technical
- PHP 8+, JSON storage, no heavy framework
- Currency demo: NOK
- App UI langs: UK, NO, EN
- Landing langs: UK, RU, EN, NO, SV, PL (hreflang + OG locale)
- Schema.org: SoftwareApplication, WebPage, FAQPage, ImageGallery, BreadcrumbList, ItemList
- Open Graph + Twitter Card (WebP og:image)
- Screenshot lightbox: enlarge, prev/next arrows, close (Esc / ✕)
